title: Near Future Laboratory Daily Headlines newsletter schema
description: Schema for newsletters built on the "near-future-lab-daily-headlines" decompiled component palette.

oneOf.title: Masthead Ad Bar
oneOf.description: Top-of-email bar with a 'View in browser' link and an inline ad image (desktop + mobile variants).

view_in_browser_href.description: Legacy URL for the 'View in browser' link. Prefer viewOnlineLink for new content.

viewOnlineLink.description: Tracked URL for the 'View in browser' link.

ad_href.description: Legacy URL the ad image links to. Prefer sponsorLink for new content.

sponsorLink.description: Tracked sponsor URL the ad image links to.

oneOf.title: Newsletter Masthead
oneOf.description: Publication logo, newsletter title image, and dateline. Top identity block for the email.

logo_href.description: Legacy URL for the logo and title links. Prefer logoLink for new content.

logoLink.description: Tracked URL for the logo and title links

viewOnlineLink.description: Build-injected tracked URL for the public issue page. Do not author this by hand.

logo_src.description: Near Future Laboratory wordmark image src

logo_alt.description: Alt text for Near Future Laboratory wordmark

logo_width.description: Rendered masthead logo width in pixels. Defaults to 190 for a reserved reference-style masthead.

title_alt.description: Alt text for newsletter title image

title_width.description: Rendered newsletter title image width in pixels. Defaults to 300.

oneOf.title: Intro Statement
oneOf.description: A short introductory editor's note or framing statement rendered below the masthead and before article groups.

label.description: Optional small uppercase label shown above the statement

statement.description:
Introductory statement. May include simple

, , , and HTML.

statement_html.description:
Optional rich HTML statement. If present, this is rendered instead of statement. Only simple

, , , and HTML is preserved.

statement_rendered_html.description: Build-generated sanitized HTML derived from statement_html or an HTML-bearing statement.

show_bottom_rule.description: Render a light divider after the statement

oneOf.title: Ad Block
oneOf.description: Inventory-backed ad card hydrated from nfl-editorial/src/content/ads.json. New ads should use this section with items[0].adId instead of hand-authored ad URLs.

title.description: Optional section title. If omitted, the inventory ad title may be promoted during hydration.

description.description: Optional issue-specific context rendered above the ad card.

show_bottom_rule.description: Render the light divider after the ad card. Defaults to true when omitted.

commerceLockup.description: Set true to render a commerce ad as its composited lockup image (price + icon baked in) instead of the plain product image. Requires commerce.lockup.snapshotSrc on the ad (generate with `npm run ads:preview -- <adId> --save-snapshot` or the editorial_ads_preview_snapshot MCP tool, then upload to Photarium). Label and sponsor still render as live text.

oneOf.title: Calendar Event
oneOf.description: Generated add-to-calendar card. The build writes an .ics file and injects calendarLink.

oneOf.title: Section Article Group
oneOf.description: A named news section (e.g. Top News, World, U.S., Politics) with a bold section heading and 1–5 article cards, each with a thumbnail image, headline, and summary, all linked.

articles.description: Structured article rows rendered with the Near Future Laboratory Daily Headlines table layout and inline font styles.

href.description: Legacy article URL. Prefer link for new content.

kicker.description: Optional byline, columnist name, or article label shown above the headline

cta_label.description: Optional visual CTA pill text rendered inside the article link

show_bottom_rule.description: Render the bottom divider used before a following 'See more' link

more_link.description: Optional section-level 'See more...' link rendered after the article rows.

href.description: Legacy URL for the section-level follow-up link. Prefer link for new content.

link.description: Tracked URL for the section-level follow-up link

label.description: Visible text for the section-level follow-up link

articles_html.description: Legacy fallback: full rendered HTML for all article rows within the section (HTML allowed)

oneOf.title: Section 'See More' Link
oneOf.description: Legacy standalone paragraph with a single 'See more [section] news' link. Prefer section_article_group.more_link for new content.

link_href.description: Legacy URL for the 'see more' link. Prefer link for new content.

link.description: Tracked URL for the 'see more' link

link_label.description: Visible text of the link (e.g. 'See more world news')

oneOf.title: Inline Ad Block
oneOf.description: Mid- or end-of-email inline advertisement with a small label image, a desktop ad image and a hidden mobile ad image.

ad_href.description: Legacy URL the ad images link to. Prefer sponsorLink for new content.

sponsorLink.description: Tracked sponsor URL the ad images link to.

oneOf.title: Tracking Pixel Row
oneOf.description: Hidden div containing a row of tiny 2×6 tracking/preheader pixel images, aria-hidden.

pixels_html.description: Full HTML of all pixel elements (HTML allowed)

oneOf.title: Share This
oneOf.description: Slim 'share this issue' CTA bar (tinted, like the footer CTA). A short statement plus a 'Forward by email' button and an optional 'Open online' button. All copy is configurable; sensible defaults render when omitted.

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the statement. Defaults to 'Share this issue'.

statement.description: One-line CTA statement. May include simple <em>/<strong>/<a> HTML. Defaults to a 'pass it along' line.

email_label.description: Label for the primary (solid) email button. Defaults to 'Forward by email'.

email_href.description: Pre-formed mailto: URL for the email button (subject/body already percent-encoded). Defaults to a generic mailto: with the online_url in the body.

online_label.description: Label for the secondary (outline) button. Defaults to 'Open online →'. Button is omitted entirely if online_url is absent.

online_url.description: Canonical public issue URL (plain string, not a tracked-link object) for the 'Open online' button and the default email body. Use the issue's archive URL, e.g. https://nearfuturelaboratory.com/newsletters/<year>/<issueId>. The build auto-stamps data-link tracking when it matches that archive pattern.

background.description: CSS color for the bar background. Defaults to '#f5f4f0' (the footer-CTA tint). Honored in light mode; dark-mode flatten overrides it (see README).

text_color.description: CSS color for the statement copy. Defaults to '#333'. Honored in light mode; dark-mode flatten overrides it.

eyebrow_color.description: CSS color for the small uppercase eyebrow label. Defaults to '#555'.

space_top.description: Vertical gap (px) above the bar so it reads as its own section rather than glued to the section above. Defaults to 28.

space_bottom.description: Vertical gap (px) below the bar. Defaults to 28.

oneOf.title: Email Footer
oneOf.description: Full footer with subscription management text, links, social icons, legal logos, and mailing address. Prefer the structured slots (paragraphs / address / unsubscribe_label / social_links); footer_html is kept as a legacy fallback used only when no structured slot is set.

paragraphs.description: Boilerplate/legal body paragraphs (the #666 block under the heavy black rule). Each entry is one paragraph's inner HTML and may contain simple inline markup including <a href> links. Add data-link-category/data-link-label to footer anchors for tracking (same convention as footer_html).

address.description: The lighter #999 legal line (organization, location, copyright). May contain an inline <a> (e.g. the publication link). Rendered in the same paragraph as the unsubscribe link, separated by a non-breaking space.

unsubscribe_label.description: Visible text for the unsubscribe link (e.g. 'Unsubscribe'). The link is omitted entirely when this is absent.

unsubscribe_href.description: Href for the unsubscribe link. Defaults to '[unsubscribe]' (the ESP merge-tag placeholder), which the live-link check leaves unvalidated.

social_links.description: Optional row of social/profile links rendered above the address line.

href.description: Destination URL. Keep it real or mailto so the live-link check passes.

footer_html.description: Legacy fallback: complete inner HTML of the footer table (the <tr><td>… rows). Used verbatim only when no structured slot (paragraphs/address/unsubscribe_label/social_links) is set.

trackedLink.description: Tracked link accepted by nfl-maizzle-mail. Object-valued links normalize to URL strings before Maizzle renders and then enrich matching anchors with data-link-label, data-link-category, data-link-interest, and data-link-intent.

sourceRef.description: Adjacency artifact slug or content entry id. Resolved to an edition-specific popup href by the newsletter build before Maizzle renders; mutually exclusive with href/url.
